welcome.title: Classic Okey and 101, in one luminous room.
welcome.body: Play offline now. Friend rooms, voice and purchases stay in safe demo mode until their providers are configured.
home.quickBody: Start a seeded bot match and resume it anytime.
home.roomsBody: Create or join a four-seat room. Online mode is a local demo for now.
room.title: Rooms
room.mockChipNotice: Chip rooms are local demos only. Chips have no cash or real-world value; production purchased-chip rooms remain disabled.
room.emptyBody: Create a private demo room and invite friends after the online provider is connected.
create.title: Create room
create.mockChipOnly: This is a local demo-chip room only; production chip rooms cannot open without legal and store approval.
create.chipDisabled: Chip rooms stay off until legal and store review is complete.
offline.title: Offline table
offline.body: Four deterministic players. The same seed produces the same deal and bot choices.
chat.title: Room chat
profile.title: Your medallion
store.title: Luma Store
store.body: Products are working local demos. No charge can occur until store and RevenueCat setup is completed.
store.vipBenefit: Cosmetics, ad-free calm and bonus convenience. Never a game advantage.
settings.title: Settings
settings.musicBody: Personal to this device; never synchronized to a room.
settings.effectsBody: Tile, meld, warning, gift, and win sounds.
settings.ambientBody: Off by default; sparse speech-free room texture at an active table.
settings.tableThemeBody: Luma uses the calm neon table; Coffeehouse uses a walnut rack, warm wood and realistic white tiles.
settings.accountBody: Apple/Google linking and account deletion appear after Firebase is configured.
safety.title: A respectful room
safety.body: Mute and block act immediately on your device. Reports are demo-only until the moderation backend is connected.
safety.noRecording: Luma Okey does not record room voice.
gift.title: Gift for {{player}}
gift.body: Gifts spend chips; recipients gain no chips or cash value.
gift.unavailable: That gift cannot be sent right now. Try again in a few seconds.
friends.title: Friends and requests
friends.requestsEmpty: Search by exact username or a safe prefix.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.room_invite: {{actor}} invited you to a private room
